label: Flow variables
subgoals: Give each commodity one variable per directed arc
Count arcs as twice the undirected edges
Multiply commodities by arcs to count variables

label: Conservation and capacity
subgoals: Write conservation at every vertex for every commodity
Write one capacity row per edge summing all commodities
Identify the capacity rows as the coupling constraints

label: Min-max utilisation
subgoals: Compute each edge's total flow divided by its capacity
Take the maximum as the utilisation of the solution
Read an optimum above one as proof of congestion
